about: Ingersoll is a town in Oxford County, Ontario, on the Thames River between London and Woodstock along Highway 401. Cheese-making heritage, a compact downtown, and a role as a manufacturing and agricultural service centre define the community. About 13,000 people live in Ingersoll.
seoSummary: Oxford County town on the Thames between London and Woodstock—cheese heritage and Highway 401 service centre.
